name: MathQA
description: We present an open source math-aware Question Answering System based on Ask Platypus. Our system returns as a single mathematical formula for a natural language question in English or Hindi. This formulae originate from the knowledge-base Wikidata.
reputation: MathQA is a widely used math word-problem dataset in the QA and reasoning literature, especially for evaluating symbolic and program-aided reasoning.
notes: This appears to be a math QA benchmark rather than a large modern LLM leaderboard target; results can vary depending on parsing and answer normalization.
